verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud ML platform, since some vendors ship on-prem or self-managed editions, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Paperspace as a hosted cloud service (VMs, Notebooks, Deployments, API/CLI). Root SSH access to rented VMs is a feature of the hosted service, not a way to self-host the product itself, and nothing in the pack documents a self-hosted or on-prem distribution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
